name: Deduplicate leads from CSV into one AI-ranked contact per company

parameters.content:
## Deduplicate leads from CSV into one AI-ranked contact per company

### How it works

This workflow accepts an uploaded spreadsheet or CSV of leads, reads the configured sheet, and groups rows by organization. For each company, it either auto-selects the only available contact or asks OpenRouter to rank multiple contacts and choose the most senior/best lead. It then merges the resolved contacts into a cleaned CSV and also generates a separate processing report.

### Setup steps

- Configure the form trigger so users can upload the lead file in the expected CSV/XLSX format.
- Set the Configuration node values, including sheetName, aiModel, and maxRowsInCleanedCSV.
- Add OpenRouter API authentication for the HTTP Request node and confirm the selected model is available to your OpenRouter account.
- Verify the input columns match the custom code expectations for organization, contact name, title, email, and any ranking fields used in the prompt.

### Customization

Adjust the grouping logic, seniority ranking prompt, OpenRouter model, and row limit to match your lead source and desired definition of the best contact per company.

## Upload and extract file

Receives the uploaded lead file, applies workflow configuration values, and extracts rows from the selected spreadsheet sheet for downstream processing.

## Group and route leads

Groups raw rows by organization, limits how many grouped companies are processed, and decides whether each company needs AI ranking or can be handled automatically.

## Rank contacts with AI

Builds a prompt for companies with multiple candidate contacts, sends it to OpenRouter, and parses the AI response to match the selected person back to the original lead data.

## Select single contacts

Handles companies that only have one contact candidate by selecting that contact without calling the AI model.

## Export resolved contacts

Combines contacts selected by the AI and no-AI paths, then converts the final deduplicated contact list into a downloadable CSV file.

## Generate processing report

Creates a report from the grouped organization data and converts it into a separate output file for auditing the deduplication process.
